# Meddleware developer documentation

> How to build on Meddleware's Sui and Walrus tooling: TypeScript SDKs, Move packages, PTB patterns, the access-gate gateway protocol, the read indexer, the shared libraries and the design system, and how to run your own relay, gateway or indexer. All repositories are public under 0BSD.

The full text of this site in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://meddleware.dev/llms-full.txt). User documentation: [docs.meddleware.co.uk/llms.txt](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/llms.txt).

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://meddleware.dev/)
- [Getting started](https://meddleware.dev/getting-started/), [toolchain](https://meddleware.dev/getting-started/toolchain), [local development](https://meddleware.dev/getting-started/local-dev)
- [Sui overview and deployments](https://meddleware.dev/sui/), [environment](https://meddleware.dev/sui/environment), [PTB patterns](https://meddleware.dev/sui/ptb-patterns)

## Products

- [Walrus Storage](https://meddleware.dev/sui/walrus-storage/): [integration](https://meddleware.dev/sui/walrus-storage/integration), [run your own upload relay](https://meddleware.dev/sui/walrus-storage/relay-self-host); SDK `@meddleware/walrus-storage-client`
- [Sealed Storage](https://meddleware.dev/sui/sealed-storage/): [integration](https://meddleware.dev/sui/sealed-storage/integration), [writing policies](https://meddleware.dev/sui/sealed-storage/policies); SDK `@meddleware/sealed-storage-client`
- [Access Gate](https://meddleware.dev/sui/access-gate/): [integration](https://meddleware.dev/sui/access-gate/integration), [gateway and wire protocol](https://meddleware.dev/sui/access-gate/gateway); SDKs `@meddleware/access-gate-client`, `@meddleware/access-gate-gateway-client`
- [Token Issuance](https://meddleware.dev/sui/token-issuance/): [template and patcher](https://meddleware.dev/sui/token-issuance/template), [deploy flow](https://meddleware.dev/sui/token-issuance/deploy); SDK `@meddleware/token-issuance-client`
- [Treasury for developers](https://meddleware.dev/sui/treasury/): [on-chain data](https://meddleware.dev/sui/treasury/data)
- [Read indexer](https://meddleware.dev/sui/indexer): the read-only event-history API

## Libraries

- [Overview](https://meddleware.dev/libraries/), [wallet-adapter](https://meddleware.dev/libraries/wallet-adapter), [web-utils](https://meddleware.dev/libraries/web-utils), [frontend-config](https://meddleware.dev/libraries/frontend-config), [walrus-storage-kit](https://meddleware.dev/libraries/walrus-storage-kit), [vitepress-theme](https://meddleware.dev/libraries/vitepress-theme)
